mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(R.FAVAILTIME ,'yyyy-MM-dd') query_date,F.FNUMBER source_eas_code,F.FNAME_L2 source_eas_name,G.FNUMBER target_eas_code, G.FNAME_L2 target_eas_name,R.FCONVERTRATE exchange_rate FROM T_BD_EXCHANGERATE R INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(FAVAILTIME) FAVAILTIME,FEXCHANGEAUXID FROM T_BD_EXCHANGERATE GROUP BY FEXCHANGEAUXID,TO_CHAR(FAVAILTIME ,'yyyyMMdd') ) A ON R.FAVAILTIME = A.FAVAILTIME AND R.FEXCHANGEAUXID = A.FEXCHANGEAUXID INNER JOIN T_BD_EXCHANGEAUX E ON R.FEXCHANGEAUXID = E.FID INNER JOIN T_BD_CURRENCY F ON E.FSOURCECURRENCYID = F.FID INNER JOIN T_BD_CURRENCY G ON E.FTARGETCURRENCYID = G.FID -- WHERE E.FTARGETCURRENCYID = 'dfd38d11-00fd-1000-e000-1ebdc0a8100dDEB58FDC' AND TO_CHAR(R.FAVAILTIME ,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{queryDate} ORDER BY TO_CHAR(R.FAVAILTIME ,'yyyy-MM-dd') DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(R.FAVAILTIME ,'yyyy-MM-dd') query_date,F.FNUMBER source_eas_code,F.FNAME_L2 source_eas_name,G.FNUMBER target_eas_code, G.FNAME_L2 target_eas_name,R.FCONVERTRATE exchange_rate FROM T_BD_EXCHANGERATE R INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(FAVAILTIME) FAVAILTIME,FEXCHANGEAUXID FROM T_BD_EXCHANGERATE GROUP BY FEXCHANGEAUXID,TO_CHAR(FAVAILTIME ,'yyyyMMdd') ) A ON R.FAVAILTIME = A.FAVAILTIME AND R.FEXCHANGEAUXID = A.FEXCHANGEAUXID INNER JOIN T_BD_EXCHANGEAUX E ON R.FEXCHANGEAUXID = E.FID INNER JOIN T_BD_CURRENCY F ON E.FSOURCECURRENCYID = F.FID INNER JOIN T_BD_CURRENCY G ON E.FTARGETCURRENCYID = G.FID -- WHERE E.FTARGETCURRENCYID = 'dfd38d11-00fd-1000-e000-1ebdc0a8100dDEB58FDC' AND TO_CHAR(R.FAVAILTIME ,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= #{queryDateStart} AND TO_CHAR(R.FAVAILTIME ,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{queryDateEnd} ORDER BY TO_CHAR(R.FAVAILTIME ,'yyyy-MM-dd') DESC
